items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉黃金從一年低點反彈逾2% 油價重挫通膨升溫疑慮
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Gold rebounds over 2% from one‑year low as oil price plunge eases inflation worries
paras: 黃金周一(2日)從上周觸及的一年低點反彈逾2%，主因是油價下挫緩解通膨升溫疑慮，同時投資人正在等待本周稍晚的美國期中選舉登場。

黃金現貨上漲2.1%，報每盎司3954.41美元，上周五曾跌3.6%，觸及2025年10月來最低。
美國12月黃金期貨收高1.8%，報每盎司3969.60美元。


由於伊朗與卡達連續第三天舉行會談，試圖結束美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，油價周一下跌約8%。
Zaner Metals副總裁暨資深金屬策略師Peter Grant說：「油價走低帶來一些喘息空間，有助於緩解通膨疑慮。不過，市場仍預期聯準會(Fed)將在12月升息，只是過去幾個交易日，這種預期的機率略有下降。」他並指出，美元走勢也稍微提供支撐。
根據芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具，交易員預期Fed 12月升息的機率為77%，低於一周前的80%。
分析師表示，科技股與AI概念股上周五遭到拋售，賣壓蔓延至各類市場。為此投資人接獲追繳保證金通知，紛紛出售黃金等避險資產，以籌措資金。
衡量資產是否處於超買或超賣狀態的14日相對強弱指數(RSI)顯示，黃金周一的指數回升至約37，高於周五的30以下，意味著金價已脫離技術面超賣區域。
市場目前將焦點轉向11月3日的美國期中選舉，以評估選舉結果對財政政策、地緣政治及整體市場情緒的潛在影響。
瑞士寶盛(Julius Baer)分析師Carsten Menke說：「美國的財政環境不太可能出現足以對金價造成影響的重大變化。無論期中選舉結果如何，財政赤字都應會持續，這意味著美國債務與利息負擔仍將是長期支撐金價的因素。」

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀回升3.1%，報每盎司50.64美元，上周五曾跌破50美元，是2025年11月底以來首見。
現貨白金上漲1.3%，報每盎司1,449.25美元。
現貨鈀金下跌1.1%，報每盎司966.08美元。
paras_en: Gold on Monday (the 2nd) rebounded more than 2% from the one‑year low it hit last week, mainly because the drop in oil prices eased concerns about rising inflation, while investors await the U.S. midterm elections later this week.

Spot gold rose 2.1% to $3,954.41 per ounce, after falling 3.6% on Friday to its lowest level since October 2025. December U.S. gold futures closed up 1.8% at $3,969.60 per ounce. Oil prices fell about 8% on Monday as Iran and Qatar held talks for the third consecutive day in an effort to end the U.S.‑Israel war with Iran.

Peter Grant, vice‑president and senior metal strategist at Zaner Metals, said: “The decline in oil prices provides some breathing room and helps ease inflation concerns. However, the market still expects the Fed to raise rates in December, although the probability of that expectation has slipped slightly over the past few trading days.” He added that the dollar’s movement also offered a modest support.
According to the CME Group’s FedWatch tool, traders now see a 77% probability of a December Fed rate hike, down from 80% a week earlier.

Analysts noted that tech and AI‑related stocks were sold off on Friday, spreading selling pressure across markets. As a result, investors received margin calls and sold safe‑haven assets such as gold to raise cash.

The 14‑day relative strength index (RSI), which measures whether an asset is overbought or oversold, rose to about 37 on Monday, up from below 30 on Friday, indicating that gold has moved out of the technical oversold zone.
Market attention has now shifted to the U.S. midterm elections on November 3, to gauge how the results might affect fiscal policy, geopolitics and overall market sentiment.

Carsten Menke, analyst at Julius Baer, said: “The U.S. fiscal environment is unlikely to see a major shift that would materially impact gold prices. Regardless of the midterm outcome, the fiscal deficit is expected to persist, meaning U.S. debt and interest‑payment burdens will remain a long‑term support for gold.”

Other precious‑metal trades: Spot silver rose 3.1% to $50.64 per ounce, after slipping below $50 on Friday – the first time since the end of November 2025. Spot platinum gained 1.3% to $1,449.25 per ounce. Spot palladium fell 1.1% to $966.08 per ounce.

items.title: 甲骨文重挫近9% 為AI支出再借款100億美元
items.title_en: Oracle Plummets Nearly 9% as It Borrows Another $10 Billion for AI Spending
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，在甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)承諾將控制籌資規模的五天後，公司卻在短短一天內，就籌足了全部 200 億美元。
甲骨文週一(2日)啟動了 100 億美元的債券發行計畫，同時向美國證券管理委員會（SEC）提交了 100 億美元的股票發行申請。兩者合計正好是公司上週投資人日(Investor Day)活動中所表示，直到 2030 會計年度為止預計籌集的全部新增債務與股權資金。
投資人並不喜歡這樣的籌資速度。甲骨文股價下跌8.76%，最低一度重挫 9%，來到 7 月以來最低，同時，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)和 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)股價則上漲。這也讓甲骨文上週投資人日活動所帶來的 11% 漲幅幾乎完全消失。
今年對甲骨文而言並不順利。過去 12 個月，甲骨文已經下跌超過一半，相較之下，微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜、Alphabet 和 Meta(META-US)股價仍與年初水準相差不遠。
那麼，甲骨文是否是大型科技股暴跌前的預警訊號？其實並不是。
甲骨文大幅下跌，並沒有成為其他大型科技公司下跌的預警。根據 Yahoo Finance 計算，自 2016 年以來，甲骨文曾有九次在三個交易日內暴跌 12% 或以上，但在接下來的一個月裡，微軟、亞馬遜、Alphabet 和 Meta 只有四次跟著下跌。此外，在 2000 年網路泡沫高峰期，以及 2021 年疫情期間的市場繁榮期，甲骨文股價見頂的時間都晚於那斯達克指數，而不是早於它。
甲骨文真正與其他科技公司不同的地方，在於它如何為 AI 基礎建設擴張籌措資金。關鍵在於它的債務。
甲骨文在上一個會計年度消耗了約 240 億美元的現金。截至 8 月，公司負債約 1,250 億美元，幾乎是股東權益的兩倍。股東權益大致代表公司償還所有債務後，理論上剩餘歸屬股東的資產價值。而週一發行的債券，又讓公司債務增加了 100 億美元。
放款機構已經注意到這個情況。根據信用違約交換（CDS）的價格，為甲骨文的債務投保、以防範違約風險，成本約是微軟的五倍。
Futurum 執行長 Daniel Newman 上週受訪時，稱微軟是「AI 領域中成熟穩健的成年人，是一家真正以最小的資產負債表損害，完成這一切的公司。」
甲骨文的借款成本也比較高。根據「The Market Ear」引用美國銀行的一份報告，甲骨文 2066 年到期的債券殖利率約為 8.4%，這代表投資人按照目前價格買進債券後，可鎖定的年化報酬率。相比之下，蘋果和微軟 2062 年到期的債券，殖利率約為 6.1%。
至於負債沉重的 AI 雲端服務供應商 CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，其借款成本甚至超過 14%。
目前，信用評等機構暫時仍對甲骨文抱持一定程度的信任。
惠譽（Fitch）維持甲骨文 BBB 的信用評等，這個等級比垃圾債券（Junk Bonds）高出兩個級距。
惠譽週一在聲明中表示，「在此次籌資完成後，預期在評等展望期間內，甲骨文不會再籌集大量額外資金。」
穆迪（Moody"s）也維持了甲骨文的信用評等，但仍將評等展望維持在「負面」，這表示未來仍存在被調降的可能性。
甲骨文並非唯一向放款機構籌資的公司。Alphabet 週一也發行了歐元計價債券，這是該公司今年第二次進行此類發行。而美國銀行經濟學家週一警告，AI 股票若持續遭到拋售，將是經濟面臨的最大風險之一，並指出，大量 AI 相關借款，是利率上升的原因之一。
惠譽認為，甲骨文目前應該已經完成籌資，不會再進一步要求資金。但放款機構收取的借款成本，卻顯示他們對此仍沒有那麼確定。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that five days after Oracle (ORCL-US) pledged to control the size of its fundraising, the company managed to raise the entire $20 billion within just one day.

On Monday (the 2nd), Oracle launched a $10 billion bond issuance and simultaneously filed a $10 billion equity offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Together, the two amount to exactly the total new debt and equity capital the company said it would raise by fiscal year 2030 during last week’s Investor Day.

Investors disliked the rapid pace of fundraising. Oracle’s share price fell 8.76%, at one point dropping almost 9% to its lowest level since July, while Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) shares rose. The 11% gain from last week’s Investor Day was therefore almost entirely erased.

The year has been rough for Oracle. Over the past 12 months the stock has fallen by more than half, whereas Microsoft (MSFT-US), Amazon, Alphabet and Meta (META-US) are still trading near their year‑start levels.
So, is Oracle a warning signal before a broader tech‑stock sell‑off? In fact, it is not.

Oracle’s sharp decline has not proven to be a warning for other large‑cap tech stocks. Yahoo Finance calculations show that since 2016 Oracle has experienced nine instances of a 12%+ drop within three trading days, but in the following month only four of Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta also fell. Moreover, during the 2000 dot‑com peak and the 2021 pandemic‑driven market boom, Oracle’s peaks came after the Nasdaq index, not before it.
What truly sets Oracle apart from other tech firms is how it is financing its AI infrastructure expansion – and the key factor is its debt.

In the prior fiscal year Oracle burned roughly $24 billion in cash. As of August, the company’s liabilities stood at about $125 billion, nearly twice its shareholders’ equity, which represents the residual asset value after all debt is repaid. The bonds issued on Monday added another $10 billion to that debt load.
Lenders have taken notice. Credit‑default‑swap (CDS) pricing indicates that insuring Oracle’s debt against default costs about five times as much as it does for Microsoft.
In an interview last week, Futurum CEO Daniel Newman described Microsoft as “the mature, steady adult in the AI space, a company that can accomplish all of this with minimal balance‑sheet damage.”

Oracle’s borrowing costs are also higher. According to a Bank of America report cited by The Market Ear, Oracle’s 2066‑maturing bonds yield about 8.4%, the annualized return investors lock in at current prices. By contrast, Apple’s and Microsoft’s 2062‑maturing bonds yield roughly 6.1%.
By comparison, the heavily indebted AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) faces borrowing costs that exceed 14%.
For now, credit‑rating agencies still retain a degree of confidence in Oracle.
Fitch maintains Oracle’s BBB rating, two notches above junk‑bond status.
In a statement on Monday, Fitch said, “Following the completion of this fundraising, Oracle is not expected to raise a substantial amount of additional capital during the rating outlook period.”
Moody’s also kept Oracle’s rating unchanged but left the outlook “negative,” indicating the possibility of a downgrade in the future.

Oracle is not the only company seeking funds from lenders. Alphabet also issued euro‑denominated bonds on Monday, its second such issuance this year. A Bank of America economist warned that continued selling of AI stocks could become one of the biggest economic risks and noted that heavy AI‑related borrowing is a driver of rising interest rates.
Fitch believes Oracle has likely finished its fundraising and will not seek further capital, yet the borrowing costs charged by lenders suggest they are still not fully convinced.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉川普稱不急於再打伊朗、鎧俠財測拖累記憶體股 費半11月首日挫逾3%
paras: 11 月開局不利，美股主要指數週一 (2 日) 多收低，資金持續撤出科技股、轉向傳統產業。美伊有望重啟和平談判，帶動油價大跌，一度提振市場情緒，但半導體與大型科技股賣壓湧現，拖累標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數由紅翻黑。道瓊則在工業與居家修繕類股支撐下，逆勢收高近 220 點，長天期公債也表現強勁。
儘管標普 500 多數成分股收紅，科技權值股與半導體股的沉重賣壓，仍使大盤未能守住早盤漲勢。那斯達克 100 指數較 10 月高點回落約 10%，進入技術性修正，費城半導體指數近三個交易日累計下跌約 11.6%。鎧俠 (Kioxia) 審慎的展望，也拖累記憶體相關個股表現。
投資人對人工智慧 (AI) 龐大支出的回報仍有疑慮，抑制逢低承接意願。科技巨頭接連籌資，更使 AI 投資的資金需求成為焦點。
甲骨文啟動合計 200 億美元的股票與債券融資，Meta 評估大規模發債，Alphabet 也重返歐元債市，加深市場對科技業財務負擔與投資回報的擔憂。
地緣政治方面，美伊釋出恢復和平談判的訊號，帶動布蘭特與西德州中質原油 (WTI) 期貨雙雙重挫逾 7%。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 表示，最高領袖已授予政府更多權限，以推動和平談判。美國總統川普週一接受《Axios》電話專訪時表示，他「不急於」決定是否恢復對伊朗的軍事行動。卡達調停方正推動重啟美伊直接談判。
本週市場還將迎來美國期中選舉、10 月就業報告與企業財報。週二登場的期中選舉中，民主黨被看好有望拿下眾議院控制權，參議院選情則仍不明朗，選舉結果及其對後續政策的影響，將牽動市場情緒。
美股週一 (2 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數下跌。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.34%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.83%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 0.30%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.83%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 2.20%。
半導體主要個股全面走低。AMD (AMD-US) 重挫 7.52%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 1.18%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 1.26%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 3.99%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 1.64%。
記憶體與儲存族群盡墨。美光 (MU-US) 大跌 5.78%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 重挫 7.52%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 大跌 6.59%；希捷 (STX-US) 重挫 7.88%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下滑 1.01%。
台股 ADR 集體淪陷。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.85%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 0.84%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 1.74%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.16%。
企業新聞
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一收跌1.83%，盤後小幅走低，蘋果盤後公布季度財報，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，這是特納斯 (John Ternus) 9 月接掌蘋果後的首份財報，也適逢蘋果推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，公司稱其為 2007 年以來 iPhone 設計最具變革性的突破。
Marvell (MRVL-US) 宣布收購 Lumentum (LITE-US)，交易企業價值達 1,150 億美元，為歷來規模最大的科技交易之一，目標是掌握資料中心支出快速成長的商機。不過，消息未能提振股價，Marvell 暴跌近 13%，Lumentum 則重摔超 18%。
甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 啟動 100 億美元普通股與 100 億美元債券發行計畫，以支應 AI 建設，股價急瀉超 8%。加速融資再次引發人們對甲骨文人工智慧擴張成本不斷攀升的擔憂。
記憶體大廠美光 (MU-US) 受到鎧俠審慎展望及大型科技公司財報引發的市場疑慮拖累，股價走弱逾 5%，至每股 833.59 美元。另外，路透分析指出，若美國期中選舉出現「藍潮」，AI 與資料中心產業可能面臨更嚴格監管，分析師點名美光、SanDisk 與希捷等記憶體及資料儲存業者，可能承受政策壓力。
英特爾 (INTC-US) 股價10月重挫45%，創史上最差單月表現，11月開局再挫超 8%，個人電腦 (PC) 市場疲弱之際，晶圓代工轉型也面臨關鍵考驗。公司為滿足伺服器處理器需求，正將奧勒岡州部分原供 18A 先進製程使用的產能，轉向較早一代的 Intel 3 製程，引發外界對其能否兼顧自家產品與外部代工客戶的疑慮。
華爾街分析
E-Trade 交易暨投資董事總經理 Chris Larkin 表示，美股長期多頭論述近幾週雖受到衝擊，但仍未瓦解。真正的挑戰在於短期動能，市場難以維持連續漲勢，因為油價飆升、AI 支出疑慮、通膨與地緣政治風險，持續干擾行情。
Larkin 指出，本週期中選舉與就業數據將帶來更多潛在波動因素，但市場承受壓力後仍能維持韌性，是一項正面訊號。
Cetera 投資長 Gene Goldman 認為，本週行程密集，使買盤格外謹慎，企業財報、期中選舉及 10 月就業報告，是牽動投資人情緒的三大因素。
Miller Tabak 分析師 Matt Maley 則表示，市場本週必須同時解讀政治與地緣政治變化，而投資人對 AI 投資回報日益加深的疑慮，對後續行情的影響，可能遠大於歷史季節性規律。
數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美國期中選舉前美元走弱 油價大跌
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Weakens Ahead of US Midterm Elections, Oil Prices Plunge
paras: 美元周一(2日)走勢疲軟，油價大幅下挫，美國公債殖利率也隨之回落。本週市場將迎來一連串重要事件，包括美國期中選舉、美國勞動市場多項經濟數據，以及多國央行的利率決策。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.22%，報 101.76，盤中一度跌至 101.42，創下 9 月 30 日以來新低。
由於伊朗與卡達官員持續就結束美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭進行談判，市場對中東地區石油供應中斷情況可能緩解的期待升高，原油價格因此暴跌約 7%。
油價回落最初帶動美國股市上漲，但科技股再度走弱。iPhone製造商蘋果在公布財報前下跌約 2%；甲骨文（Oracle）則因計劃透過發行債券與股票籌資 200 億美元，股價重挫逾 8%。
近幾週，市場對企業在新興 AI 技術上投入龐大資金的疑慮日益加深，拖累股市表現，也使美元受惠於避險需求而獲得支撐。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「整體而言，市場展現出相當強的韌性。12 月交割的西德州中級原油（WTI）期貨價格週五一度測試每桶 105 美元，如今已跌破 100 美元。」

paras_en: The dollar was weak on Monday (the 2nd), and oil prices fell sharply, with US Treasury yields also retreating. This week the market will face a series of important events, including the US midterm elections, multiple US labor market data releases, and interest‑rate decisions by several central banks.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.22% to 101.76, after dipping intraday to 101.42, a low not seen since September 30.

Because Iranian and Qatari officials continued negotiations to end the US‑Israel war with Iran, market expectations that disruptions to Middle‑East oil supply might ease rose, sending crude oil prices down about 7%.

The oil‑price drop initially lifted US equities, but tech stocks weakened again. Apple, the iPhone maker, slipped about 2% ahead of its earnings release; Oracle fell more than 8% after announcing plans to raise $20 billion through a bond and stock offering.
In recent weeks, concerns have deepened that companies are pouring huge sums into emerging AI technologies, dragging down equity performance and giving the dollar a boost as a safe‑haven asset.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said, "Overall, the market has shown considerable resilience. December‑delivery West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures tested $105 a barrel on Friday and have now slipped below $100."

He added, "Going into the weekend, market conditions looked pretty grim. Stocks were falling and December WTI futures had even set a new contract high. But after the weekend, when trading resumed, the market collectively seemed to breathe a sigh of relief."
Even though Fitch last Friday downgraded France’s credit outlook from "stable" to "negative" amid worsening debt conditions, the euro still rose 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1192.
October manufacturing index rises

On the data front, the US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the October manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 from September’s 54.5, indicating continued expansion in factory activity while input costs remain elevated.
The market this week will also see a slew of labor‑market data, with Friday’s US non‑farm payroll report slated as the headline event.

S&P Global’s euro‑area manufacturing PMI showed that October manufacturing activity in the euro zone remained robust, though growth slowed slightly as new‑order growth decelerated and higher energy prices and supply‑chain disruptions pushed up costs, further squeezing corporate profit margins.
Several central banks are also expected to announce policy decisions this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Australia, Norway and Sweden.

US voters will head to the polls on Tuesday to decide whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from the Republican Party of President Trump. Economic conditions and rising prices are the main issues for voters.
The market broadly expects Democrats to win a majority of seats in the House, but gaining control of the Senate is seen as a tougher challenge.
The pound rose 0.1% against the dollar to £1 = $1.3406.

PMI data show that UK manufacturing output at the start of the final quarter of 2026 posted its strongest growth in more than two years. However, rapidly rising costs could worry the Bank of England, and markets anticipate a possible rate hike this week.
The dollar gained 0.23% against the yen, reaching ¥157.89 per $1.

paras: 伊朗釋出願意透過對話解決戰爭的訊號,加上伊朗與卡達官員持續協商結束美以戰爭,市場對中東原油供應恢復的期待升高,國際油價11月2日重挫逾7%。布蘭特原油 (Brent) 期貨下跌8.66美元,跌幅7.63%,收每桶104.77美元;美國西德州中級原油 (WTI) 下跌7.66美元,跌幅7.36%,收每桶96.46美元。盤中布蘭特最低跌至103.28美元,WTI最低觸及95.15美元。
油價大跌主要受到伊朗最高領袖釋出談判空間的消息影響。伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)表示,最高領袖穆吉塔巴·哈米尼(Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei)已授權政府在和平談判方面採取特定行動,並稱德黑蘭將嘗試透過對話解決問題。伊朗談判代表已與卡達調停人員連續多日會談,討論結束戰爭的可能方案。
美國總統川普也表示,伊朗希望達成結束戰爭的協議,並認為協議有可能實現。卡達調停人員則於11月2日晚間前往德黑蘭,與伊朗外交部長阿拉奇(Abbas Araqchi)會談,討論美伊協議的可能性。外交進展降低市場對衝突進一步升級的擔憂,促使投資人下調原油供應中斷風險溢價。

不過,市場對談判能否成功仍抱持保留態度。雷蒙詹姆斯金融公司(Raymond James)分析師帕維爾·莫爾恰諾夫(Pavel Molchanov)指出,美伊談判出現進展的跡象推低油價,但過去數月已多次出現看似有望突破、最後卻未能實現的情況,因此仍須審慎看待。瑞銀集團(UBS)分析師喬瓦尼·斯塔烏諾(Giovanni Staunovo)也表示,油市對中東每一則消息都高度敏感,上周市場因擔憂衝突迫近升級而推高油價,本周則因美伊外交談判持續而快速回落。
布蘭特原油10月底曾收在六個月高點,主要因市場擔憂美國期中選舉後中東衝突可能再度升級。近期荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲事件增加,進一步加深市場對能源運輸受阻的疑慮。不過,部分主要出口國的出貨量也出現回升跡象,沙烏地阿拉伯10月原油出口較9月增加,三家船舶追蹤機構中有兩家確認這項趨勢,儘管沙國能源設施仍遭到與伊朗結盟的葉門胡塞武裝組織攻擊。
供應面仍是油價後續走勢的重要支撐。阿布達比國家石油公司(ADNOC)執行長蘇丹·賈比爾(Sultan Al Jaber)表示,自2月底伊朗戰爭爆發、荷姆茲海峽航運受到干擾以來,全球原油庫存已累計消耗近10億桶。這代表即使外交談判帶動油價短線回落,全球能源庫存仍相當緊張,若運輸或生產再度受到衝擊,市場可能迅速重新反映供應風險。
高盛(Goldman Sachs)則警告,中東供應風險仍可能推升油價。該行11月1日上調油價預測,若波斯灣原油產量持續低於2025年平均水準每日350萬桶,布蘭特原油2027年可能升至每桶140美元。高盛指出,油輪遇襲增加、能源基礎設施受損,以及市場持續存在的供應風險溢價,都是油價進一步上漲的主要觸發因素。
整體而言,伊朗釋出談判意願,使市場暫時降低對中東戰事擴大的預期,促成油價單日大幅修正。然而,近10億桶庫存消耗、荷姆茲海峽航運風險及能源設施受損等問題尚未完全解除。後續油價能否持續回落,仍取決於美伊談判是否取得實質進展、航運能否恢復正常,以及波斯灣原油產量是否回升。
paras_en: Iran signaled a willingness to resolve the war through dialogue, and ongoing talks between Iranian and Qatari officials to end the US‑Israel conflict have raised market expectations of a rebound in Middle‑East crude supply. International oil prices slumped more than 7% on November 2. Brent futures fell $8.66, a 7.63% drop, closing at $104.77 a barrel; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) fell $7.66, a 7.36% decline, closing at $96.46 a barrel. Brent touched a intraday low of $103.28, while WTI hit $95.15.

The sharp price fall was mainly driven by news that Iran’s Supreme Leader had opened a negotiating window. President Masoud Pezeshkian said Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei had authorized the government to take specific steps toward peace talks and that Tehran would try to resolve the issue through dialogue. Iran’s negotiating team has been meeting for several days with Qatari mediators to discuss possible war‑ending scenarios.

U.S. President Donald Trump also said Iran wants to reach a war‑ending agreement and that such a deal could be achievable. Qatari mediators traveled to Tehran on the evening of November 2 to meet Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi and discuss the prospects of a U.S.–Iran accord. The diplomatic progress eased market fears of further conflict escalation, prompting investors to lower the risk premium for supply disruptions.

Nevertheless, the market remains cautious about the likelihood of a successful negotiation. Raymond James analyst Pavel Molchanov noted that while signs of progress in U.S.–Iran talks have pushed oil lower, the past few months have seen several seemingly promising breakthroughs that failed to materialise, so caution is warranted. UBS analyst Giovanni Staunovo added that the oil market is highly sensitive to every Middle‑East development; last week prices were lifted by fears of a conflict escalation, and this week they fell sharply as diplomatic talks continued.

Brent had closed at a six‑month high at the end of October, mainly because the market feared a post‑U.S. mid‑term election flare‑up in Middle‑East tensions. Recent attacks on tankers in the Hormuz Strait have further deepened concerns about energy transport disruptions. However, shipment volumes from some major exporters are showing signs of recovery – Saudi Arabia’s October crude exports rose versus September, a trend confirmed by two of three vessel‑tracking agencies, even though Saudi energy facilities continue to be targeted by Yemen’s Iran‑aligned Houthi forces.

Supply fundamentals remain a key support for future price moves. Sultan Al Jaber, CEO of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), said that since the outbreak of the Iran‑related war at the end of February and the ensuing Hormuz shipping disruptions, global crude inventories have been drawn down by nearly 1 billion barrels. This means that even if diplomatic talks trigger a short‑term price dip, global energy stocks remain tight, and any further hit to transport or production could quickly revive supply‑risk premiums.

Goldman Sachs warned that Middle‑East supply risks could still lift oil prices. The bank raised its oil price forecast on November 1, noting that if Persian Gulf output stays below the 2025 average of 3.5 million barrels per day, Brent could reach $140 a barrel by 2027. Goldman pointed to the rise in tanker attacks, damage to energy infrastructure and the persistent supply‑risk premium as the main triggers for further price gains.

Overall, Iran’s willingness to negotiate has temporarily lowered market expectations of a broader Middle‑East war, prompting a sharp one‑day correction in oil prices. Yet the consumption of almost 1 billion barrels of inventory, ongoing Hormuz shipping risks and damage to energy facilities have not been fully resolved. Whether prices continue to fall will depend on substantive progress in U.S.–Iran talks, the restoration of normal shipping, and a rebound in Persian Gulf crude production.

paras_en: Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) sees a breakthrough in the long‑running China Hua‑Ying case, holding a major press conference on the 2nd. Both sides have negotiated and each held board meetings, approving a settlement target of RMB 768 million (about NT$3.756 billion). If the settlement documents are signed, the company could recover nearly NT$10 billion of losses, adding roughly NT$4.6 to pre‑tax earnings per share.

The Labor Fund posted a new high. The Labor Fund Management Office released its latest performance on the 2nd, showing a September single‑month gain of NT$117.8 billion. For the first nine months of the year, cumulative profit reached NT$2.4405 trillion, a 30.73% return. Under the new labor‑retirement scheme, cumulative earnings rose to NT$1.70442 trillion. Assuming the 13.1 million active accounts share the profit, the average dividend per worker is NT$130,100, breaking the NT$130,000 threshold.

Although the index has expanded for 13 consecutive months (above the 50% neutral line), the expansion pace slowed, slipping 0.9 percentage points from the previous month to 62.5. The institute remains optimistic about the outlook, noting that growth sources and operational challenges differ across industries.

Airline fuel surcharges will rise again. The Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transportation announced on the 2nd that, due to recent increases in jet fuel prices, the international‑flight fuel surcharge for national carriers will be adjusted upward starting November 8. This is the fourth consecutive hike: short‑haul routes will see a US$40 increase (about NT$1,302), while long‑haul routes will rise from US$97.5 to US$104 (about NT$3,387), adding roughly NT$211 to the long‑haul surcharge.

Memory‑chip giant Winbond (2337‑TW) chairman Wu Min‑chiu said on the 2nd that he is confident the memory industry will stay robust through 2030, with prices expected to remain at least as strong as today. paras: 美國總統川普週一 (2 日) 表示，他「不急於」決定是否恢復對伊朗的軍事行動。在美國期中選舉前夕，這番表態顯示，他仍願意給外交談判時間，但尚未排除再次動武。
川普接受《Axios》電話專訪時表示：「無論如何，我們都會採取某種行動，但不急於一時。我們已在財務上重創他們。他們沒有錢、沒有汽油，人民也越來越厭倦這種局面。」
美國 11 月 3 日期中選舉，原被外界視為川普決定是否對伊朗發動大規模轟炸、試圖結束戰爭的關鍵時間點。
不過，《Axios》報導中指出，川普至少目前仍將延續雙軌策略，一方面讓談判繼續，另一方面為可能恢復作戰做準備，若認定協議無法達成，仍可能轉向軍事行動。
川普表示，美伊正在接觸，談判「進展順利」，但他認為伊朗試圖拖延，展現的急迫感不如外界預期。他同時指出，伊朗達成協議的意願，比以往任何時候都強烈。
據區域消息人士透露，卡達斡旋方已擬定一份協議草案，規劃分三天依序實施建立互信措施，為美伊恢復直接談判鋪路。
不過，報導未揭露各階段的具體措施。一名知情外交官表示，斡旋方目前正等待華府與德黑蘭回覆，草案尚未獲雙方同意。
然而，川普政府內部對下一步行動存在分歧。
《Axios》指出，川普正在權衡三條路線，分別是達成協議、恢復作戰，以及持續施加經濟壓力。
副總統范斯 (JD Vance) 與白宮特使威特科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 主張推動協議，理由是重啟戰爭未必能改善現況。消息人士指出，多數波灣國家也支持外交途徑，並已向川普表達立場。
美國國防部長赫格塞斯 (Pete Hegseth) 則支持恢復軍事行動。他與以色列總理尼坦雅胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 認為，不能相信伊朗會達成協議，更不能相信德黑蘭會遵守承諾，因此主張以軍事手段完成目標。
第三條路線則獲財政部長貝森特 (Scott Bessent)、中央情報局局長拉特克里夫 (John Ratcliffe) 及國務卿盧比歐 (Marco Rubio) 支持。
消息人士表示，三人建議維持「不開戰、也不達成協議」的現狀，讓經濟施壓持續發揮作用。
一名直接知情人士透露，拉特克里夫向川普表示，長期經濟困境可能迫使伊朗做出更多讓步，也可能加劇內部動盪，甚至引發民眾反抗。中央情報局對此不予置評。
伊朗文人政府週一則對外交前景釋出較正面的訊號。
總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 表示，最高領袖穆吉塔巴(Mojtaba Khamenei) 已授予政府部分權限，嘗試透過外交達成協議。
伊朗外長阿拉奇 (Abbas Araghchi) 表示，外交往來已變得「非常密集」，卡達與巴基斯坦正積極居中斡旋。
他指出，伊朗已提出條件與方案，接下來取決於華府的政治判斷；若美方選擇真正的外交，伊朗願意接觸，但若企圖欺騙並採取軍事行動，將面臨比過去更嚴厲的回應。
阿拉奇並表示，若美國接受伊朗就重新開放荷姆茲海峽提出的條件，談判便會恢復；否則，現狀將持續，伊朗不會屈服。
俄羅斯與中國也參與促談。
俄羅斯總統普丁週一與伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書雷扎伊 (Mohsen Rezaei) 通話，討論外交協議。
俄方另提出，可透過接收伊朗濃縮鈾庫存等方式參與未來核協議。雷扎伊的副手同日訪問北京，與中國外交部長會面，中方也敦促美伊恢復直接談判。
川普 10 月 8 日曾宣布，美國不會在 11 月 3 日期中選舉前攻擊伊朗。隨著投票日逼近，他最新表示不急於決定是否恢復軍事行動，顯示選舉結束未必意味戰事立即重啟。不過，據《Axios》報導，川普仍在讓談判繼續的同時，為可能恢復作戰做準備，尚未排除軍事選項。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 2nd) that he "is not in a hurry" to decide whether to resume military action against Iran. On the eve of the U.S. midterm elections, this statement shows he is still willing to give diplomacy time, but has not ruled out another strike.

In a phone interview with Axios, Trump said, "Anyway, we will take some action, but we are not in a hurry. We have already hit them financially. They have no money, no gasoline, and their people are getting more and more tired of this situation."
The U.S. November 3 midterm election has been seen by observers as the key moment for Trump to decide whether to launch a large‑scale bombing of Iran and try to end the war.

However, Axios reports that Trump is at least for now continuing a dual‑track strategy: letting negotiations proceed on one hand while preparing for a possible resumption of combat on the other, and if he judges that an agreement cannot be reached, he may still turn to military action.

Trump said the U.S. and Iran are in contact and that negotiations are "progressing smoothly," but he believes Iran is trying to stall and does not show the urgency that outsiders expect. He also noted that Iran's willingness to reach a deal is stronger than ever.
According to regional sources, the Qatari mediation team has drafted an agreement that outlines three days of sequential confidence‑building measures to pave the way for direct U.S.–Iran talks.

The report did not disclose the specific measures for each stage. A knowledgeable diplomat said the mediators are currently waiting for responses from Washington and Tehran, and the draft has not yet been accepted by either side.
Nevertheless, there is disagreement within the Trump administration about the next steps.
Axios notes that Trump is weighing three paths: reaching an agreement, resuming combat, or continuing economic pressure.

Vice President JD Vance and White House envoy Steve Witkoff are pushing for a deal, arguing that restarting the war may not improve the situation. Sources say most Gulf states also favor a diplomatic route and have conveyed that stance to Trump.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth backs a return to military action. He and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu say Iran cannot be trusted to reach a deal or honor any commitments, so they favor achieving the goal by force.
The third path is supported by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, CIA Director John Ratcliffe and Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
Sources say the three officials recommend maintaining the status quo of "no war and no agreement" so that economic pressure can continue to work.

A directly informed source said Ratcliffe told Trump that prolonged economic hardship could force Iran to make more concessions, could heighten internal unrest, and might even spark popular revolt. The CIA declined to comment.
Iran's reformist government on Monday sent a more positive signal about diplomatic prospects.
President Masoud Pezeshkian said Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has granted the government limited authority to try to achieve a deal through diplomacy.
Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said diplomatic contacts have become "very intensive," with Qatar and Pakistan actively mediating.

He noted that Iran has put forward conditions and proposals, and the next step depends on Washington's political judgment; if the U.S. chooses genuine diplomacy, Iran is ready to engage, but if it tries to deceive and use military force, Iran will respond more harshly than before.

Araghchi added that if the United States accepts the conditions Iran offered for reopening the Hormuz Strait, negotiations will resume; otherwise the status quo will continue and Iran will not capitulate.
Russia and China are also involved in promoting talks.
Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke on Monday with Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, about a diplomatic agreement.

Russia also suggested it could take part in a future nuclear deal by receiving Iran's enriched uranium stockpiles, among other measures. Rezaei's deputy visited Beijing the same day, met with China's foreign minister, and Beijing also urged the U.S. and Iran to resume direct talks.

Trump announced on October 8 that the United States would not attack Iran before the November 3 midterm election. As the voting day approaches, his latest comment that he is not in a hurry to decide on resuming military action shows that the end of the election does not necessarily mean an immediate restart of hostilities. However, Axios reports that Trump is still letting negotiations continue while preparing for a possible return to combat and has not ruled out the military option.

paras_en: Da‑Tong (2371‑TW) sees a breakthrough in the long‑running China Hua‑Ying case, holding a major press conference on the 2nd. Both sides have negotiated and each held board meetings, approving a settlement target of RMB 768 million (about NT$3.756 billion). If the settlement documents are signed, the company could recover nearly NT$10 billion of losses, adding roughly NT$4.6 to pre‑tax earnings per share.

The Labor Fund posted a new high. The Labor Fund Management Office released its latest performance on the 2nd, showing a September single‑month gain of NT$117.8 billion. For the first nine months of the year, cumulative profit reached NT$2.4405 trillion, a 30.73% return. Under the new labor‑retirement scheme, cumulative earnings rose to NT$1.70442 trillion. Assuming the 13.1 million active accounts share the profit, the average dividend per worker is NT$130,100, breaking the NT$130,000 threshold.

The Chung‑Hua Economic Research Institute reported October’s Taiwan Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) on the 2nd. Although the index has expanded for 13 consecutive months (above the 50% neutral line), the expansion pace slowed, slipping 0.9 percentage points from the previous month to 62.5. The institute remains optimistic about the outlook, noting that growth sources and operational challenges differ across industries.

Airline fuel surcharges will rise again. The Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transportation announced on the 2nd that, due to recent increases in jet fuel prices, the international‑flight fuel surcharge for national carriers will be adjusted upward starting November 8. This is the fourth consecutive hike: short‑haul routes will see a US$40 increase (about NT$1,302), while long‑haul routes will rise from US$97.5 to US$104 (about NT$3,387), adding roughly NT$211 to the long‑haul surcharge.

Memory‑chip giant Winbond (2337‑TW) chairman Wu Min‑chiu said on the 2nd that he is confident the memory industry will stay robust through 2030, with prices expected to remain at least as strong as today. AI‑driven demand continues to heat up, and current capacity is “scarce,” so the company will allocate more capacity to high‑end niche products and launch many new products next year.

items.title: 00949擬配3.02元配息率衝破13% 掀起日股ETF高息話題
items.title_en: 00949 Plans NT$3.02 Dividend, Yield Over 13% Sparks High‑Yield Japanese‑Stock ETF Talk
paras: 近期全球科技股波動加劇，市場資金開始重新檢視投資組合的風險分散與收益來源。日股ETF配息表現也成為市場關注焦點，其中復華日本龍頭(00949-TW)最新宣布配發每受益權單位3.02元，以今(2)日收盤價 22.1 元推算，年配息率突破 13%，不僅展現亮眼的收益表現，更寫下台灣掛牌日股ETF的配息新紀錄。
過去台灣掛牌的日本股票ETF，多以追蹤日本主要股價指數、掌握日股長期成長機會為訴求，配息並非市場關注的主要焦點。相較之下，00949此次宣布配發3.02元，以推估年配息率超過13%的水準來看，明顯有別於過往日股ETF的配息表現。若與市場既有日股ETF歷史配息紀錄比較，過去尚未出現年化配息率突破10%的案例，此次配息因此格外受到矚目。
值得注意的是，近期美國大型科技股及AI相關族群受到市場對企業資本支出、獲利成長與評價水準的重新檢視，股價波動明顯加大。在全球股市連動性提高的環境下，投資人若過度集中於單一市場或科技產業，投資組合可能承受較大的短期波動。因此，透過不同國家與產業的資產配置分散風險，重要性也隨之提升。
日本股市近年受惠於企業治理改革、股東報酬意識提升，以及企業積極推動資本效率改善，逐漸吸引國際資金關注。相較於高度集中在少數大型科技企業的投資組合，日本市場涵蓋金融、工業、消費、汽車及電子等多元產業，可作為投資人拓展海外股票配置的選項之一。
市場人士指出，對於已持有美股科技ETF、台灣科技型ETF或AI相關投資部位的投資人而言，適度納入日股ETF，不僅有助於拓展投資區域，也能增加不同產業與企業獲利來源的曝險。若搭配具備配息機制的產品，更可兼顧海外股市參與及現金流需求，提升投資組合的配置彈性。
不過，投資人仍須留意，ETF配息率並不等同於投資報酬率，單次高額配息也不代表未來能持續維持相同水準。評估日股ETF時，除觀察配息金額與年化配息率外，也應綜合考量基金淨值變化、配息來源、總報酬表現、匯率風險及標的指數特性，避免單純以高配息率作為投資依據。

paras_en: Recent global tech‑stock volatility has intensified, prompting investors to re‑examine portfolio risk diversification and sources of return. The dividend performance of Japanese‑stock ETFs in Taiwan has become a market focus, and Fu‑Hua Japan Leader (00949‑TW) just announced a distribution of NT$3.02 per unit. Using today’s (the 2nd) closing price of NT$22.1, the annualized dividend yield exceeds 13%, setting a new dividend record for Taiwan‑listed Japanese‑stock ETFs.

Historically, Taiwan‑listed Japanese equity ETFs have mainly tracked Japan’s major indices and emphasized long‑term growth opportunities, with dividends not being a primary market focus. In contrast, 00949’s announcement of a NT$3.02 payout, implying an annualized yield above 13%, is markedly different from past Japanese‑stock ETF dividend performance. Compared with historical yields of existing Japanese‑stock ETFs, none have ever broken a 10% annualized dividend yield, making this payout especially noteworthy.

It is worth noting that large U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks have recently faced renewed scrutiny over capital expenditures, profit growth, and valuation levels, leading to markedly higher price volatility. In an environment of heightened global market correlation, investors overly concentrated in a single market or tech sector may experience larger short‑term swings. Hence, diversifying across countries and industries becomes increasingly important for risk mitigation.

Japan’s stock market has benefited in recent years from corporate governance reforms, heightened shareholder‑pay awareness, and active efforts to improve capital efficiency, gradually attracting international capital. Compared with portfolios heavily weighted toward a few large tech firms, Japan offers a broader mix of financials, industrials, consumer, automotive and electronics sectors, providing investors with another option for overseas equity allocation.

Market participants note that investors already holding U.S. tech ETFs, Taiwan tech‑focused ETFs, or AI‑related positions can benefit from modestly adding Japanese‑stock ETFs. This not only broadens geographic exposure but also adds exposure to different industries and corporate earnings sources. When paired with dividend‑paying products, it can satisfy both overseas market participation and cash‑flow needs, enhancing portfolio flexibility.

However, investors should remember that an ETF’s dividend yield is not equivalent to its total return, and a one‑time large payout does not guarantee future consistency. When evaluating Japanese‑stock ETFs, beyond the dividend amount and annualized yield, one should also consider NAV changes, dividend sources, total return performance, currency risk, and the characteristics of the underlying index, avoiding reliance solely on high yields as an investment basis.

items.title: 十銓：記憶體缺貨尚未達高峰「到明年Q2最吃緊」 千坪新廠估增5成產能
items.title_en: TenQ: Memory Shortage Not Yet at Peak, "Tightest Until Q2 Next Year" New 1,000-Ping Factory Expected to Boost Capacity by 50%
paras: 記憶體模組廠十銓(4967-TW)今(2)日召開法說，公司表示，這波記憶體景氣循環與過去不同，主要受到產業結構改變、原廠及模組廠寡占化影響，價格已連漲一年，短期內看不到反轉跡象，且真正缺貨最嚴重的時刻還沒到，預估今年第四季至明年第二季末將是供貨最吃緊的階段，不排除出現有錢也買不到貨的情況。
十銓表示，目前全球記憶體供應主要集中在三星、美光及SK海力士，台灣及中國大陸業者雖持續擴產，但短期產量仍不足以左右整體市場供需，加上主要模組廠也逐漸寡占化，價格主導能力提高，使這波景氣循環不同於過去每兩至六個月就出現一次波動的情況，短期內價格仍有支撐。
十銓指出，第四季至明年第一季記憶體價格仍將持續上漲，部分缺貨較嚴重的產品，過去每季合約價格漲幅約30%至40%，預期漲勢仍將延續。其中，LPDDR5X隨著應用從手機擴大至新一代AI運算設備，單一設備搭載量提高，也進一步推升需求。
供貨方面，十銓與各大原廠合作近30年，透過長期交易紀錄及長期供貨協議(LTA)爭取貨源。截至第三季底，庫存金額約172億元，其中DRAM占75%、NAND Flash占25%，後續將以伺服器、工控長期訂單客戶及高階消費性產品為主要備貨方向，採取邊買邊賣策略，買得到多少就供應多少。
消費性市場方面，十銓表示，手機及一般PC在記憶體供貨分配上相對處於劣勢，PC業者已透過降低記憶體規格控制整機成本，預期明年情況仍難明顯改善，消費性模組市場可能要到2028年下半年才有機會迎來轉機。
面對記憶體市場結構轉變，十銓也同步調整營運組織，將既有業務整合為企業暨工控應用、品牌暨通路兩大事業群。其中，企業暨工控應用事業群聚焦伺服器記憶體、企業級SSD、工控及邊緣AI應用，強化產品驗證導入與技術服務；品牌暨通路事業群則運用逾20年全球品牌及通路經營經驗，鎖定高階電競、專業工作站及創作者市場，深化系統整合商(SI)與通路夥伴合作。
至於毛利率持續走高，十銓指出，除了記憶體售價上漲，也受惠於產品及客戶組合轉變，B2B營收比重已提高至約65%，逐步轉向AI伺服器、工業電腦及高技術門檻應用。由於這類客戶對價格的承受度較高，且長期訂單逐漸增加，加上庫存成本與銷售價格的時間差，有助於支撐整體獲利表現，且目前庫存操作維持健康，隨產品組合持續朝高階應用發展，對後續毛利率仍具信心。
為支援企業級及工控業務發展，十銓也在新北市新購約千坪廠房，規劃導入自動化生產設備，以因應少量多樣的產品需求。新廠預計2027年第一季展開裝修及設備進駐，第二季完工投產，屆時可增加約50%產能，並透過兩座工廠的生產調度提高製程彈性。同時，透過兩大事業群分工，深化高階消費性產品及全球通路經營，同時擴大企業級與工控應用布局，配合新廠投產增加產能，掌握記憶體市場需求及產業轉型商機。
paras_en: Memory module maker TenQ (4967-TW) held a briefing today, stating that the current memory cycle differs from the past, driven by industry structural changes and increasing concentration among OEMs and module makers. Prices have risen continuously for a year, with no short‑term reversal in sight, and the most severe shortage has not yet arrived. The company forecasts that the tightest supply period will be from Q4 this year through the end of Q2 next year, and it may even reach a point where money cannot secure inventory.

TenQ noted that global memory supply is now dominated by Samsung, Micron and SK Hynix. Although Taiwanese and mainland Chinese players are expanding capacity, their short‑term output remains insufficient to sway overall market balance. Meanwhile, the consolidation of major module manufacturers is enhancing price‑setting power, making this cycle unlike the past where fluctuations occurred every two to six months, and price support is expected to persist in the near term.

The firm expects memory prices to keep rising through Q4 and into Q1 next year. For products experiencing the sharpest shortages, contract prices have historically jumped 30‑40% each quarter, and this upward trend is expected to continue. In particular, LPDDR5X demand is being boosted as its use expands from smartphones to next‑generation AI computing devices, increasing the per‑device memory count.

On the supply side, TenQ has partnered with major OEMs for nearly 30 years, leveraging long‑term transaction records and long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to secure shipments. By the end of Q3, inventory was valued at about NT$17.2 billion, with DRAM accounting for 75% and NAND flash 25%. Going forward, the company will prioritize stocking for server, industrial‑control long‑term orders and high‑end consumer products, adopting a buy‑as‑you‑sell approach – supplying as much as it can procure.

In the consumer market, TenQ said that smartphones and typical PCs are at a disadvantage in memory allocation. PC makers have been lowering memory specifications to control system costs, and the situation is unlikely to improve noticeably next year. The consumer module market may not see a turnaround until the second half of 2028.

Facing the shift in memory market structure, TenQ is reorganizing its operations, consolidating existing sales into two business groups: Enterprise & Industrial Applications and Brand & Channel. The former focuses on server memory, enterprise‑grade SSDs, industrial control and edge AI, strengthening product validation and technical services; the latter leverages over 20 years of global brand and channel experience to target high‑end gaming, professional workstations and creator markets, deepening cooperation with system integrators and channel partners.

Regarding rising gross margins, TenQ attributed the improvement not only to higher memory prices but also to a shift in product and customer mix. B2B revenue now makes up about 65% of sales, moving toward AI servers, industrial PCs and high‑tech applications. These customers have higher price tolerance and growing long‑term orders, and the timing gap between inventory cost and sales price supports overall profitability. Inventory remains healthy, and as the product mix continues toward high‑end applications, the company remains confident about future margins.

To support its enterprise and industrial businesses, TenQ is acquiring a roughly 1,000‑ping (≈3,300 sqm) plant in New Taipei City, planning to install automated production equipment to meet low‑volume, high‑variety demand. The new factory is slated for renovation and equipment installation in Q1 2027, with completion and start‑up in Q2, boosting capacity by about 50%. Coordinated production across the two sites will enhance process flexibility, while the two business groups will deepen high‑end consumer product and global channel operations, expand enterprise and industrial application coverage, and capture memory market demand and transformation opportunities.

items.title: AI高速傳輸需求升溫 法人看好眾達-KY 400G、800G產品放量
items.title_en: AI High-Speed Transmission Demand Rises, Institutional Investors Favor Zhongda-KY’s 400G and 800G Products Scaling Up
paras: 台股光通訊廠眾達-KY (4977-TW) 受惠於雲端服務供應商(CSP)持續擴大AI基礎建設投資，帶動資料中心高速傳輸需求快速升溫，隨著各大CSP對高階網路交換器的傳輸速率要求不斷提升，產業規格正加速朝400G、800G世代推進。法人也預估，眾達-KY明(2027)年400G產品將持續放量，800G產品也將逐步跟上，成為推升營運成長的主要動能。
眾達-KY專注於高速光收發模組的研發與製造，目前市場關注焦點主要集中在400G、800G等高階產品的出貨進度，以及公司在雷射光學封裝領域與博通(Broadcom)的合作布局，相關發展也成為觀察高速光通訊產業升級的重要指標。
隨著AI伺服器運算規模持續擴大，資料傳輸瓶頸已成為資料中心建置的重要課題。當傳輸速率由400G邁向800G，甚至進一步朝1.6T發展，資料傳輸架構也逐漸走向光電整合、光銅並進的趨勢。其中，短距離傳輸仍以銅纜為主，以兼顧成本與功耗；中長距離及高頻寬傳輸需求，則更多仰賴光通訊技術支援，帶動高速光收發模組的滲透率持續提升，成為AI資料中心升級的重要環節。
從目前眾達-KY產品營收結構來看，400G及800G產品合計已占營收約六成。其中，法人預估400G產品營收占比約達40%至50%，800G產品則隨出貨逐步升溫，營收貢獻有望持續增加，未來占比可望進一步擴大，成為產品組合升級及營運成長的重要支柱。
法人表示，眾達-KY正積極投入矽光子相關應用技術的產品發展活動，配合公司長期合作夥伴博通的研發進度，預計順利完成客戶認證後，有望開始放量投產。
paras_en: Taiwan’s optical communications maker Zhongda‑KY (4977‑TW) is benefiting from cloud service providers (CSPs) continuously expanding AI infrastructure investments, which is heating up demand for high‑speed data‑center transmission. As major CSPs raise the required transmission rates of high‑end network switches, industry standards are rapidly moving toward the 400G and 800G generations. Institutional investors estimate that Zhongda‑KY’s 400G products will keep ramping up in 2027, with 800G products following suit, becoming a key driver of the company’s operational growth.

Zhongda‑KY focuses on the R&D and manufacturing of high‑speed optical transceiver modules. Market attention is now centered on the shipment progress of high‑end 400G and 800G products and the company’s collaborative layout with Broadcom in laser‑optical packaging, which has become an important indicator for tracking the upgrade of the high‑speed optical communications industry.

As AI server compute scales continue to expand, data‑transfer bottlenecks have become a critical issue for data‑center construction. When transmission rates move from 400G toward 800G—and eventually toward 1.6T—the data‑transfer architecture is shifting toward a hybrid of photonic integration and copper. Short‑reach transmission remains copper‑cable‑dominant to balance cost and power consumption, while mid‑ to long‑reach, high‑bandwidth needs rely increasingly on optical‑communication technology, driving higher penetration of high‑speed optical transceiver modules and becoming a vital link in AI data‑center upgrades.

Looking at Zhongda‑KY’s current product revenue mix, 400G and 800G products together already account for about 60% of revenue. Institutional investors estimate that 400G contributes roughly 40%–50% of revenue, while 800G’s share is rising as shipments heat up, with its contribution expected to grow further and become a major pillar of the company’s product portfolio upgrade and operational growth.

Institutions note that Zhongda‑KY is actively investing in silicon‑photonics‑related application technologies, aligning with its long‑term partner Broadcom’s R&D timeline. After successful customer certification, the company expects to commence full‑scale production and volume ramp‑up.

items.title: 台積電供應鏈迅得對半導體設備出貨走揚 10月營收改寫歷史次高
items.title_en: TSMC Supply Chain's Shunde Sees Semiconductor Equipment Shipments Rise, October Revenue Rewrites Historic Second‑Highest
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)供應鏈設備大廠迅得(6438-TW)營收在半導體業務推進一如預期，10 月營收維持在 6 億元以上高檔，今(2)日揭露以 6.73億元改寫歷史單月次高，也創同期新高，月減3.15%、年增28.08%；累計 2026 年 1-10 月營收達61.86億元，年增 10.93%。
迅得 2026 年第三季營收達 19.45 億元，季增 6.64%、年增 13.62%，單季營收刷新歷史紀錄。法人預估，第四季營收將可維持在此一歷史高檔水準之上。
迅得投資 1.5 億元取得南科友上科技 23% 股權後，公司高層透露，目前仍有其他投資案持續推進中。同時，為因應持續湧入的設備訂單，迅得最快將於今年底至明年初在台灣南部取得土地興建新廠，全面提升產能供給。
在營運效益方面，迅得營運總部遷入新生廠後產能已達滿載，進一步推升獲利表現。2026 年上半年營收 35.68 億元，年增 11.99%，毛利率 26.13%，稅後純益 3.11 億元，每股純益(EPS)達 3.79 元。2026 年第二季營收 18.24 億元創高，稅後純益 1.66 億元，優於首季的 1.45 億元，單季 EPS 為 2.03 元。
隨著迅得安排出貨的半導體設備於第四季步入出貨高峰，加上產品組合優化，下半年營運將顯著優於上半年。法人預估，迅得 2026 全年營收將較 2025 年的 64.67 億元成長 10%–15%，續創歷史新高；在產品組合有利因素加持下，獲利成長幅度更有望達到營收增幅的倍數呈現。
迅得同時具備半導體與 PCB 設備雙重成長動能，在 PCB 領域，公司鎖定高階載板與板廠需求，目前已握有臻鼎-KY(4958-TW)及景碩(3189-TW)等大廠確立訂單。
paras_en: Shunde (6438‑TW), a major equipment supplier in TSMC's supply chain, saw semiconductor business advance as expected, with October revenue staying above NT$600 million. Today (2nd) it disclosed NT$673 million, rewriting the historic single‑month second‑highest and setting a new high for the period, down 3.15% month‑over‑month, up 28.08% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for Jan‑Oct 2026 reached NT$6.186 billion, up 10.93% YoY.
Shunde's Q3 2026 revenue hit NT$1.945 billion, up 6.64% sequentially and 13.62% YoY, a quarterly record. Analysts estimate Q4 revenue will stay above this historic high level.

After investing NT$150 million to acquire a 23% stake in Youshang Technology of the Southern Science Park, management said other investment projects are still progressing. To cope with the influx of equipment orders, Shunde plans to acquire land in southern Taiwan by year‑end to early next year to build a new plant, fully boosting capacity.

On the operational side, after moving its headquarters to the new plant, capacity is now fully utilized, further improving profitability. H1 2026 revenue was NT$3.568 billion, up 11.99% YoY, gross margin 26.13%, net profit NT$311 million, EPS NT$3.79. Q2 2026 revenue reached a record NT$1.824 billion, net profit NT$166 million, higher than Q1’s NT$145 million, with quarterly EPS of NT$2.03.

With Shunde’s semiconductor equipment shipments entering a peak in Q4 and product‑mix optimization, H2 performance is expected to be markedly better than H1. Analysts project 2026 full‑year revenue to grow 10‑15% over 2025’s NT$6.467 billion, setting a new historic high; profit growth could outpace revenue growth, potentially multiples of the revenue increase.

Shunde also has dual growth drivers in semiconductor and PCB equipment. In the PCB segment, the company targets high‑end substrates and fab demand, and has already secured orders from major players such as Zhen Ding‑KY (4958‑TW) and Jing Shuo (3189‑TW).

items.title: 00980A受益人數暴增近130% 年化配息率12%
items.title_en: 00980A Beneficiary Numbers Surge Nearly 130% Annual Yield 12%
paras: 外資在上月賣超台股9,943.17億元，創下歷史最高單月賣超紀錄。台股從月初光輝十月行情，一度衝上49,968.92點，距五萬點大關僅一步之遙，隨後卻在高利率、AI投資回收疑慮與外資賣壓交織下震盪走低，並於最後一個交易日跌破半年線成悲傷十月，美股更是慘遭血血洗。面對劇烈波動，主動野村台灣優選（00980A-TW）受益人數年增近130%，今(2) 日公布第一階段收益分配公告，每單位擬配發0.688元，按今日收盤價22.79元換算，單次配息率為3.02%，年化配息率為12.08%。
00980A本次除息交易日為11月17日，最後買進日為11月16日，收益分配預計於12月11日發放。
觀察2020年以來不含本次之十大外資賣超月份，平均單月賣超金額達4,655.27億元，加權指數當月平均下跌4.95%；但若將時間拉長至六個月，加權指數則平均上漲17.48%。野村投信表示，外資集中賣超雖可能加重短期市場壓力，中期行情仍須回歸企業獲利與產業趨勢觀察，投資人可在震盪中檢視基本面，評估分批布局機會。
00980A基金經理人游景德表示，今年台股較大幅度的震盪集中在4月、7月與10月，適逢季報公布與美國大型雲端服務供應商（CSP）擴大資本支出的時點，反映市場對AI融資成本與投資延續性的關注。不過，最新科技巨頭財報顯示，雲端與AI需求仍持續成長，五大CSP明年資本支出預估上修至1.3兆美元，AI基礎建設投資循環尚未見頂。
游景德指出，野村投信內部股票池預估，2026年企業每股盈餘年增率已上修至80.3%，連續10個月上修；新一代AI平台Vera Rubin於今年第四季末至明年第一季初進入量產，可望帶動相關供應鏈營收成長。儘管個別公司訂單與產品規格調整的消息可能影響市場情緒，台灣廠商在伺服器滑軌、ABF載板及散熱等領域的競爭優勢仍具支撐，投資人可透過定期定額分散進場時點，依資金規劃逢低分批加碼。
00980A採季配息機制，成立於2025年4月22日，為台股首檔主動式ETF，受益人數已達71,476人，較去年同期成長129.68%。
paras_en: Foreign investors sold Taiwanese stocks worth NT$9,943.17 billion last month, setting a record for the highest single‑month net sell‑off. The market, which had risen to 49,968.92 points early in the month and was just a step away from the 50,000‑point milestone, later slipped amid high interest rates, concerns over AI investment returns and foreign‑investor selling pressure, breaking below the six‑month moving average on the final trading day and delivering a sad October, while U.S. stocks suffered a brutal sell‑off. Amid the volatility, Nomura Taiwan Select (00980A‑TW) saw its beneficiary count rise by almost 130% year‑over‑year and today (the 2nd) announced the first‑stage dividend distribution, proposing a payout of NT$0.688 per unit, which translates to a one‑time yield of 3.02% based on today’s closing price of NT$22.79 and an annualised yield of 12.08%.
The ex‑dividend date for 00980A is November 17, the last purchase day is November 16, and the dividend distribution is scheduled for December 11.

Looking at the ten months with the largest foreign‑investor net sell‑offs since 2020 (excluding the current one), the average monthly net sell‑off was NT$4,655.27 billion and the weighted index fell an average of 4.95% that month; however, over a six‑month horizon the index rose an average of 17.48%. Nomura Asset Management says that while concentrated foreign selling may increase short‑term pressure, the medium‑term market will revert to fundamentals such as corporate earnings and industry trends, and investors can use the volatility to assess fundamentals and evaluate opportunities for staggered positioning.

Fund manager You Jing‑de of 00980A noted that this year’s major swings in the Taiwan market were concentrated in April, July and October, coinciding with quarterly earnings releases and the timing of increased capital expenditures by major U.S. cloud service providers (CSPs), reflecting market focus on AI financing costs and investment continuity. Nevertheless, the latest earnings from tech giants show that cloud and AI demand remain robust, with the five largest CSPs revising next‑year cap‑ex forecasts up to $1.3 trillion, indicating the AI infrastructure investment cycle has not peaked yet.

You Jing‑de added that Nomura’s internal stock pool now projects the 2026 corporate earnings per share growth rate up to 80.3%, a revision sustained for ten consecutive months. The next‑generation AI platform Vera Rubin is expected to enter mass production from late Q4 this year into early Q1 next year, which should boost revenue for related supply‑chain firms. Although news of order changes or product specifications at individual companies may sway sentiment, Taiwanese manufacturers retain competitive advantages in server rails, ABF substrates and cooling solutions, supporting the sector. Investors can adopt a regular‑interval, dollar‑cost‑averaging approach to add positions on dips according to their capital plans.

00980A employs a quarterly dividend policy, was launched on April 22 2025, and is Taiwan’s first actively managed ETF. Its beneficiary count has reached 71,476, up 129.68% from the same period last year.

items.title: 耐特預計11/19掛牌上市 11/4競拍起跑底價62.5元
items.title_en: Naiter Plans November 19 Listing; Auction Starts November 4 with Base Price of NT$62.5
paras: 高性能複合材料廠耐特(8058-TW)配合上市前公開承銷，對外競價拍賣4896張，競拍底價62.5元，最高投標張數612張，暫定每股承銷價80元。競拍時間為11月4日至6日，11月10日開標；11月9日至11日辦理公開申購，11月13日抽籤，預計11月19日掛牌。
耐特近三年營收規模持續成長，2023年至2025年合併營收分別為21.01億元、23.7億元及24.68億元，每股純益分別為1.06元、2.27元及1.95元。2026年上半年營收14.21億元、毛利4.19億元，毛利率約29%、營業利益率約11%、每股純益達1.85元。
從營收結構來看，半導體與BBU相關用料占比已從2023年的3.59%，提升至2024年的11.09%、2025年的20.94%，2026年上半年進一步達25.76%。其中，半導體用料占比已接近兩成；BBU材料則受惠AI伺服器及資料中心對備援電力安全性要求提高，持續朝高耐熱、阻燃及絕緣等高規格應用發展，顯示兩大高階材料業務已逐步從新興布局轉為實質營收來源。
為因應高階材料需求，耐特於2024年至2026年間陸續增設半導體專用潔淨產線及IC Tray專線。目前彰化廠共有13條產線，包括2條半導體專線及2條IC Tray專線；上海廠則有7條產線，其中2條為半導體專線，兩地合計20條產線。隨著客戶認證逐步完成、量產規模擴大，2026年上半年產能利用率已回升至70%，顯示前期擴產效益逐漸顯現。
在半導體材料方面，耐特中高階晶圓載具及光罩盒相關材料已通過客戶認證並穩定量產，中低階載具材料也已進入量產供貨階段。雖然目前相關載具占整體營收比重仍低於5%，但透過既有量產實績及終端客戶驗證經驗，公司已逐步累積高潔淨、低釋氣、抗靜電及尺寸穩定等關鍵材料技術能力，為後續拓展高階半導體應用奠定基礎。
此外，IC Tray也是耐特積極拓展的高階應用市場。由於IC載盤材料須具備穩定的抗靜電性能，以避免靜電對晶片造成影響，耐特已導入潔淨製程，並透過配方技術提升抗靜電效果的均勻性，同時開發可耐150°C高溫的載盤材料。目前相關材料已進入量產供貨階段，後續將配合國際客戶成品驗證及導入進度，逐步擴大應用範圍。

根據Grand View Research研究，全球塑膠複合材料市場規模預估將由2024年的805億美元，成長至2030年的1,082億美元，年複合成長率約5%。隨著AI運算、半導體先進製程及高功率電子設備持續升級，對高性能複合材料的需求也同步增加。耐特表示，未來將持續聚焦半導體載具、IC Tray及BBU三大高附加價值應用，結合客製化配方研發、潔淨製程及既有量產實績，進一步強化產品競爭力與營運成長動能。
paras_en: Naiter (8058‑TW), a high‑performance composite materials manufacturer, is conducting a pre‑IPO public underwriting auction of 4,896 shares at a base price of NT$62.5, with the highest bid quantity of 612 shares and a provisional underwriting price of NT$80 per share. The auction runs from November 4 to 6, with the opening bid on November 10; public subscription is from November 9 to 11, the lottery on November 13, and the listing is expected on November 19.

Over the past three years Naiter’s revenue has continuously grown, with consolidated revenue of NT$2.101 billion, NT$2.37 billion and NT$2.468 billion for 2023, 2024 and 2025 respectively, and earnings per share of NT$1.06, NT$2.27 and NT$1.95. In the first half of 2026 revenue reached NT$1.421 billion, gross profit NT$419 million (gross margin about 29%), operating profit margin about 11%, and EPS of NT$1.85.

From a revenue‑mix perspective, semiconductor‑related and BBU‑related materials rose from 3.59% of total revenue in 2023 to 11.09% in 2024, 20.94% in 2025 and further to 25.76% in the first half of 2026. Semiconductor materials now account for nearly 20% of sales; BBU materials benefit from higher safety requirements for power redundancy in AI servers and data centers, driving development toward high‑heat‑resistance, flame‑retardant and insulating specifications, indicating that these two high‑end material lines are shifting from emerging projects to substantive revenue sources.

To meet demand for high‑end materials, Naiter has added dedicated semiconductor clean lines and IC‑Tray lines between 2024 and 2026. The Changhua plant now has 13 production lines, including two semiconductor lines and two IC‑Tray lines; the Shanghai plant has seven lines, two of which are semiconductor lines, for a total of 20 lines across both sites. With customer certifications progressing and mass‑production volumes expanding, capacity utilization rose to 70% in the first half of 2026, showing the early benefits of the expansion are materializing.

In semiconductor materials, Naiter’s mid‑to‑high‑end wafer carriers and photomask box materials have passed customer certification and are in stable mass production, while low‑to‑mid‑end carrier materials have entered volume supply. Although carrier materials currently represent less than 5% of total revenue, the company has gradually built key capabilities—high cleanliness, low outgassing, antistatic performance and dimensional stability—through existing production records and end‑customer validation, laying a foundation for future high‑end semiconductor applications.

IC‑Tray is also a focus for Naiter’s high‑end market expansion. Because IC‑Tray materials must provide stable antistatic performance to protect chips from static discharge, Naiter has introduced clean‑process manufacturing and formulation technology to improve the uniformity of antistatic effects, and has developed tray material that can withstand 150 °C. These materials are now in volume supply and will be further expanded as international customers complete product verification and adoption.

According to Grand View Research, the global plastic composite materials market is projected to grow from US$80.5 billion in 2024 to US$108.2 billion by 2030, at a compound annual growth rate of about 5%. As AI computing, advanced semiconductor processes and high‑power electronic equipment continue to evolve, demand for high‑performance composites rises in tandem. Naiter says it will keep focusing on three high‑value‑add applications—semiconductor carriers, IC‑Trays and BBU—leveraging customized formulation R&D, clean‑process manufacturing and existing mass‑production experience to further strengthen product competitiveness and growth momentum.

items.title: 甲骨文重挫近9% 為AI支出再借款100億美元
items.title_en: Oracle Plummets Nearly 9% as It Borrows Another $10 Billion for AI Spending
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，在甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)承諾將控制籌資規模的五天後，公司卻在短短一天內，就籌足了全部 200 億美元。
甲骨文週一(2日)啟動了 100 億美元的債券發行計畫，同時向美國證券管理委員會（SEC）提交了 100 億美元的股票發行申請。兩者合計正好是公司上週投資人日(Investor Day)活動中所表示，直到 2030 會計年度為止預計籌集的全部新增債務與股權資金。
投資人並不喜歡這樣的籌資速度。甲骨文股價下跌8.76%，最低一度重挫 9%，來到 7 月以來最低，同時，亞馬遜(AMZN-US)和 Alphabet(GOOGL-US)股價則上漲。這也讓甲骨文上週投資人日活動所帶來的 11% 漲幅幾乎完全消失。
今年對甲骨文而言並不順利。過去 12 個月，甲骨文已經下跌超過一半，相較之下，微軟(MSFT-US)、亞馬遜、Alphabet 和 Meta(META-US)股價仍與年初水準相差不遠。
那麼，甲骨文是否是大型科技股暴跌前的預警訊號？其實並不是。
甲骨文大幅下跌，並沒有成為其他大型科技公司下跌的預警。根據 Yahoo Finance 計算，自 2016 年以來，甲骨文曾有九次在三個交易日內暴跌 12% 或以上，但在接下來的一個月裡，微軟、亞馬遜、Alphabet 和 Meta 只有四次跟著下跌。此外，在 2000 年網路泡沫高峰期，以及 2021 年疫情期間的市場繁榮期，甲骨文股價見頂的時間都晚於那斯達克指數，而不是早於它。
甲骨文真正與其他科技公司不同的地方，在於它如何為 AI 基礎建設擴張籌措資金。關鍵在於它的債務。
甲骨文在上一個會計年度消耗了約 240 億美元的現金。截至 8 月，公司負債約 1,250 億美元，幾乎是股東權益的兩倍。股東權益大致代表公司償還所有債務後，理論上剩餘歸屬股東的資產價值。而週一發行的債券，又讓公司債務增加了 100 億美元。
放款機構已經注意到這個情況。根據信用違約交換（CDS）的價格，為甲骨文的債務投保、以防範違約風險，成本約是微軟的五倍。
Futurum 執行長 Daniel Newman 上週受訪時，稱微軟是「AI 領域中成熟穩健的成年人，是一家真正以最小的資產負債表損害，完成這一切的公司。」
甲骨文的借款成本也比較高。根據「The Market Ear」引用美國銀行的一份報告，甲骨文 2066 年到期的債券殖利率約為 8.4%，這代表投資人按照目前價格買進債券後，可鎖定的年化報酬率。相比之下，蘋果和微軟 2062 年到期的債券，殖利率約為 6.1%。
至於負債沉重的 AI 雲端服務供應商 CoreWeave(CRWV-US)，其借款成本甚至超過 14%。
目前，信用評等機構暫時仍對甲骨文抱持一定程度的信任。
惠譽（Fitch）維持甲骨文 BBB 的信用評等，這個等級比垃圾債券（Junk Bonds）高出兩個級距。
惠譽週一在聲明中表示，「在此次籌資完成後，預期在評等展望期間內，甲骨文不會再籌集大量額外資金。」
穆迪（Moody"s）也維持了甲骨文的信用評等，但仍將評等展望維持在「負面」，這表示未來仍存在被調降的可能性。
甲骨文並非唯一向放款機構籌資的公司。Alphabet 週一也發行了歐元計價債券，這是該公司今年第二次進行此類發行。而美國銀行經濟學家週一警告，AI 股票若持續遭到拋售，將是經濟面臨的最大風險之一，並指出，大量 AI 相關借款，是利率上升的原因之一。
惠譽認為，甲骨文目前應該已經完成籌資，不會再進一步要求資金。但放款機構收取的借款成本，卻顯示他們對此仍沒有那麼確定。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that five days after Oracle (ORCL-US) pledged to control the size of its fundraising, the company managed to raise the entire $20 billion within just one day.

On Monday (the 2nd), Oracle launched a $10 billion bond issuance and simultaneously filed a $10 billion equity offering with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Together, the two amount to exactly the total new debt and equity capital the company said it would raise by fiscal year 2030 during last week’s Investor Day.

Investors disliked the rapid pace of fundraising. Oracle’s share price fell 8.76%, at one point dropping almost 9% to its lowest level since July, while Amazon (AMZN-US) and Alphabet (GOOGL-US) shares rose. The 11% gain from last week’s Investor Day was therefore almost entirely erased.

The year has been rough for Oracle. Over the past 12 months the stock has fallen by more than half, whereas Microsoft (MSFT-US), Amazon, Alphabet and Meta (META-US) are still trading near their year‑start levels.
So, is Oracle a warning signal before a broader tech‑stock sell‑off? In fact, it is not.

Oracle’s sharp decline has not proven to be a warning for other large‑cap tech stocks. Yahoo Finance calculations show that since 2016 Oracle has experienced nine instances of a 12%+ drop within three trading days, but in the following month only four of Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta also fell. Moreover, during the 2000 dot‑com peak and the 2021 pandemic‑driven market boom, Oracle’s peaks came after the Nasdaq index, not before it.
What truly sets Oracle apart from other tech firms is how it is financing its AI infrastructure expansion – and the key factor is its debt.

In the prior fiscal year Oracle burned roughly $24 billion in cash. As of August, the company’s liabilities stood at about $125 billion, nearly twice its shareholders’ equity, which represents the residual asset value after all debt is repaid. The bonds issued on Monday added another $10 billion to that debt load.
Lenders have taken notice. Credit‑default‑swap (CDS) pricing indicates that insuring Oracle’s debt against default costs about five times as much as it does for Microsoft.
In an interview last week, Futurum CEO Daniel Newman described Microsoft as “the mature, steady adult in the AI space, a company that can accomplish all of this with minimal balance‑sheet damage.”

Oracle’s borrowing costs are also higher. According to a Bank of America report cited by The Market Ear, Oracle’s 2066‑maturing bonds yield about 8.4%, the annualized return investors lock in at current prices. By contrast, Apple’s and Microsoft’s 2062‑maturing bonds yield roughly 6.1%.
By comparison, the heavily indebted AI cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV-US) faces borrowing costs that exceed 14%.
For now, credit‑rating agencies still retain a degree of confidence in Oracle.
Fitch maintains Oracle’s BBB rating, two notches above junk‑bond status.
In a statement on Monday, Fitch said, “Following the completion of this fundraising, Oracle is not expected to raise a substantial amount of additional capital during the rating outlook period.”
Moody’s also kept Oracle’s rating unchanged but left the outlook “negative,” indicating the possibility of a downgrade in the future.

Oracle is not the only company seeking funds from lenders. Alphabet also issued euro‑denominated bonds on Monday, its second such issuance this year. A Bank of America economist warned that continued selling of AI stocks could become one of the biggest economic risks and noted that heavy AI‑related borrowing is a driver of rising interest rates.
Fitch believes Oracle has likely finished its fundraising and will not seek further capital, yet the borrowing costs charged by lenders suggest they are still not fully convinced.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉川普稱不急於再打伊朗、鎧俠財測拖累記憶體股 費半11月首日挫逾3%
paras: 11 月開局不利，美股主要指數週一 (2 日) 多收低，資金持續撤出科技股、轉向傳統產業。美伊有望重啟和平談判，帶動油價大跌，一度提振市場情緒，但半導體與大型科技股賣壓湧現，拖累標普 500 指數與那斯達克指數由紅翻黑。道瓊則在工業與居家修繕類股支撐下，逆勢收高近 220 點，長天期公債也表現強勁。
儘管標普 500 多數成分股收紅，科技權值股與半導體股的沉重賣壓，仍使大盤未能守住早盤漲勢。那斯達克 100 指數較 10 月高點回落約 10%，進入技術性修正，費城半導體指數近三個交易日累計下跌約 11.6%。鎧俠 (Kioxia) 審慎的展望，也拖累記憶體相關個股表現。
投資人對人工智慧 (AI) 龐大支出的回報仍有疑慮，抑制逢低承接意願。科技巨頭接連籌資，更使 AI 投資的資金需求成為焦點。
甲骨文啟動合計 200 億美元的股票與債券融資，Meta 評估大規模發債，Alphabet 也重返歐元債市，加深市場對科技業財務負擔與投資回報的擔憂。
地緣政治方面，美伊釋出恢復和平談判的訊號，帶動布蘭特與西德州中質原油 (WTI) 期貨雙雙重挫逾 7%。
伊朗總統裴澤斯基安 (Masoud Pezeshkian) 表示，最高領袖已授予政府更多權限，以推動和平談判。美國總統川普週一接受《Axios》電話專訪時表示，他「不急於」決定是否恢復對伊朗的軍事行動。卡達調停方正推動重啟美伊直接談判。
本週市場還將迎來美國期中選舉、10 月就業報告與企業財報。週二登場的期中選舉中，民主黨被看好有望拿下眾議院控制權，參議院選情則仍不明朗，選舉結果及其對後續政策的影響，將牽動市場情緒。
美股週一 (2 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數下跌。Meta (META-US) 下跌 1.34%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.83%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 0.30%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 2.83%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 2.20%。
半導體主要個股全面走低。AMD (AMD-US) 重挫 7.52%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 1.18%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 1.26%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 3.99%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 1.64%。
記憶體與儲存族群盡墨。美光 (MU-US) 大跌 5.78%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 重挫 7.52%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 大跌 6.59%；希捷 (STX-US) 重挫 7.88%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下滑 1.01%。
台股 ADR 集體淪陷。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.85%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 0.84%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 1.74%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.16%。
企業新聞
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 週一收跌1.83%，盤後小幅走低，蘋果盤後公布季度財報，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，這是特納斯 (John Ternus) 9 月接掌蘋果後的首份財報，也適逢蘋果推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo，公司稱其為 2007 年以來 iPhone 設計最具變革性的突破。
Marvell (MRVL-US) 宣布收購 Lumentum (LITE-US)，交易企業價值達 1,150 億美元，為歷來規模最大的科技交易之一，目標是掌握資料中心支出快速成長的商機。不過，消息未能提振股價，Marvell 暴跌近 13%，Lumentum 則重摔超 18%。
甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 啟動 100 億美元普通股與 100 億美元債券發行計畫，以支應 AI 建設，股價急瀉超 8%。加速融資再次引發人們對甲骨文人工智慧擴張成本不斷攀升的擔憂。
記憶體大廠美光 (MU-US) 受到鎧俠審慎展望及大型科技公司財報引發的市場疑慮拖累，股價走弱逾 5%，至每股 833.59 美元。另外，路透分析指出，若美國期中選舉出現「藍潮」，AI 與資料中心產業可能面臨更嚴格監管，分析師點名美光、SanDisk 與希捷等記憶體及資料儲存業者，可能承受政策壓力。
英特爾 (INTC-US) 股價10月重挫45%，創史上最差單月表現，11月開局再挫超 8%，個人電腦 (PC) 市場疲弱之際，晶圓代工轉型也面臨關鍵考驗。公司為滿足伺服器處理器需求，正將奧勒岡州部分原供 18A 先進製程使用的產能，轉向較早一代的 Intel 3 製程，引發外界對其能否兼顧自家產品與外部代工客戶的疑慮。
華爾街分析
E-Trade 交易暨投資董事總經理 Chris Larkin 表示，美股長期多頭論述近幾週雖受到衝擊，但仍未瓦解。真正的挑戰在於短期動能，市場難以維持連續漲勢，因為油價飆升、AI 支出疑慮、通膨與地緣政治風險，持續干擾行情。
Larkin 指出，本週期中選舉與就業數據將帶來更多潛在波動因素，但市場承受壓力後仍能維持韌性，是一項正面訊號。
Cetera 投資長 Gene Goldman 認為，本週行程密集，使買盤格外謹慎，企業財報、期中選舉及 10 月就業報告，是牽動投資人情緒的三大因素。
Miller Tabak 分析師 Matt Maley 則表示，市場本週必須同時解讀政治與地緣政治變化，而投資人對 AI 投資回報日益加深的疑慮，對後續行情的影響，可能遠大於歷史季節性規律。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美國期中選舉前美元走弱 油價大跌
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Weakens Ahead of US Midterm Elections, Oil Prices Plunge
paras: 美元周一(2日)走勢疲軟，油價大幅下挫，美國公債殖利率也隨之回落。本週市場將迎來一連串重要事件，包括美國期中選舉、美國勞動市場多項經濟數據，以及多國央行的利率決策。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.22%，報 101.76，盤中一度跌至 101.42，創下 9 月 30 日以來新低。
由於伊朗與卡達官員持續就結束美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭進行談判，市場對中東地區石油供應中斷情況可能緩解的期待升高，原油價格因此暴跌約 7%。
油價回落最初帶動美國股市上漲，但科技股再度走弱。iPhone製造商蘋果在公布財報前下跌約 2%；甲骨文（Oracle）則因計劃透過發行債券與股票籌資 200 億美元，股價重挫逾 8%。
近幾週，市場對企業在新興 AI 技術上投入龐大資金的疑慮日益加深，拖累股市表現，也使美元受惠於避險需求而獲得支撐。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「整體而言，市場展現出相當強的韌性。12 月交割的西德州中級原油（WTI）期貨價格週五一度測試每桶 105 美元，如今已跌破 100 美元。」
他接著表示，「週末前，市場情勢看起來相當糟糕。股市下跌，12 月 WTI 原油期貨更創下合約新高。但週末過後重新開市，市場彷彿集體鬆了一口氣。」
即使惠譽（Fitch）在上週五稍晚，因法國債務狀況持續惡化，將法國的信用評等展望從「穩定」調降至「負面」，歐元兌美元仍上漲 0.3%，來到 1 歐元兌 1.1192 美元。
10 月製造業指數上升
在經濟數據方面，美國供應管理協會（ISM）公布，10 月製造業採購經理人指數（PMI）從 9 月的 54.5 上升至 55.5，顯示製造業活動持續擴張，而投入成本仍維持在較高水準。
本週市場也將迎來一系列勞動市場數據，並以週五美國政府公布的 10 月非農就業報告作為重頭戲。
標普全球（S&P Global）公布的歐元區製造業 PMI 顯示，10 月歐元區製造業活動仍維持良好的成長態勢，不過成長速度略有放緩，主要原因是新訂單成長減速，加上能源價格與供應鏈中斷造成成本上升，進一步壓縮企業利潤空間。
本週也有多家央行預計公布貨幣政策決議，包括英國、澳洲、挪威及瑞典央行。
美國選民將於週二前往投票所，決定民主黨是否從美國總統川普所屬的共和黨手中奪回國會控制權。經濟狀況與物價高漲是選民關注的主要議題。
市場普遍預測，民主黨有望贏得眾議院多數席次，但要進一步取得參議院控制權，難度可能較高。
英鎊兌美元上漲 0.1%，來到 1 英鎊兌 1.3406 美元。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，英國製造業在 2026 年最後一季開始時，產出成長創兩年多來最強勁的表現。不過，快速攀升的成本可能令英國央行(BoE)感到憂慮，市場預期英國央行本週可能升息。
美元兌日元上漲 0.23%，來到 157.89 日元。
日本央行(BoJ)在其季度經濟展望報告完整版中指出，日本實質利率近期已有所上升，尤其是在長天期與超長天期利率區間。

This week the market will face a series of important events, including the US midterm elections, multiple US labor market data releases, and interest‑rate decisions by several central banks.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.22% to 101.76, after dipping intraday to 101.42, a low not seen since September 30.

Because Iranian and Qatari officials continued negotiations to end the US‑Israel war with Iran, market expectations that disruptions to Middle‑East oil supply might ease rose, sending crude oil prices down about 7%.

The oil‑price drop initially lifted US equities, but tech stocks weakened again. Apple, the iPhone maker, slipped about 2% ahead of its earnings release; Oracle fell more than 8% after announcing plans to raise $20 billion through a bond and stock offering.
In recent weeks, concerns have deepened that companies are pouring huge sums into emerging AI technologies, dragging down equity performance and giving the dollar a boost as a safe‑haven asset.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said, "Overall, the market has shown considerable resilience. December‑delivery West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures tested $105 a barrel on Friday and have now slipped below $100."

He added, "Going into the weekend, market conditions looked pretty grim. Stocks were falling and December WTI futures had even set a new contract high. But after the weekend, when trading resumed, the market collectively seemed to breathe a sigh of relief."
Even though Fitch last Friday downgraded France’s credit outlook from "stable" to "negative" amid worsening debt conditions, the euro still rose 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1192.
October manufacturing index rises

On the data front, the US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the October manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 from September’s 54.5, indicating continued expansion in factory activity while input costs remain elevated.
The market this week will also see a slew of labor‑market data, with Friday’s US non‑farm payroll report slated as the headline event.

S&P Global’s euro‑area manufacturing PMI showed that October manufacturing activity in the euro zone remained robust, though growth slowed slightly as new‑order growth decelerated and higher energy prices and supply‑chain disruptions pushed up costs, further squeezing corporate profit margins.
Several central banks are also expected to announce policy decisions this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Australia, Norway and Sweden.

US voters will head to the polls on Tuesday to decide whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from the Republican Party of President Trump. Economic conditions and rising prices are the main issues for voters.
The market broadly expects Democrats to win a majority of seats in the House, but gaining control of the Senate is seen as a tougher challenge.
The pound rose 0.1% against the dollar to £1 = $1.3406.

The dollar gained 0.23% against the yen, reaching ¥157.89 per $1.
